data.description:
## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
- DD4: deep-tier specialist delta files include explicit negative constraints ('Emit findings only in your owned category')
- DD1: No reviewer agent definition file contains references to REVIEW_RESULT, MIN_SCORE, or a scores object in its output contract

## Files to modify
All 10 delta files in plugins/dso/docs/workflows/prompts/:
- reviewer-delta-light.md
- reviewer-delta-standard.md
- reviewer-delta-deep-correctness.md
- reviewer-delta-deep-verification.md
- reviewer-delta-deep-hygiene.md
- reviewer-delta-deep-arch.md
- reviewer-delta-security-red-team.md
- reviewer-delta-security-blue-team.md
- reviewer-delta-performance.md
- reviewer-delta-test-quality.md

## Changes required in EVERY delta file

### 1. Remove N/A score instructions
Search for and remove any sections instructing agents how to handle N/A scores:
- Patterns to remove: 'N/A score', 'score.*N/A', 'when to use N/A', 'N/A.*dimension'
- Also remove any instructions about score ranges (e.g., 'scores 1-5', '3 or lower fails')

### 2. Remove any REVIEW_RESULT references
If any delta file references REVIEW_RESULT, MIN_SCORE, or scores object → remove them.
(reviewer-base.md is the authoritative source; delta files should not duplicate output contract)

## Additional changes for DEEP-TIER specialist delta files ONLY

For reviewer-delta-deep-correctness.md, reviewer-delta-deep-verification.md, reviewer-delta-deep-hygiene.md — add an explicit negative constraint near the beginning of each delta:

Add after the opening section heading:

## Scope Constraint (Deep-Tier Specialists)
**You own one category only.** Emit findings ONLY in your assigned dimension:
- deep-correctness: correctness findings only
- deep-verification: verification findings only
- deep-hygiene: hygiene findings only

**Do NOT** emit findings in dimensions owned by other specialists. If you observe an issue in another dimension, note it in your summary but do NOT include it as a finding (it will be duplicated by the appropriate specialist).

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] All 10 delta files have no N/A score instructions
  Verify: ! grep -rq 'N/A.*score\|score.*N/A\|"N/A"' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/docs/workflows/prompts/reviewer-delta-*.md
- [ ] Deep-tier delta files contain negative scope constraint
  Verify: grep -q 'Do NOT.*findings\|Emit findings ONLY' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/docs/workflows/prompts/reviewer-delta-deep-correctness.md
- [ ] test-reviewer-blindspot-annotations.sh passes (7/7 after T2+T4)
  Verify: bash $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/docs/test-reviewer-blindspot-annotations.sh 2>&1 | grep -q 'PASSED'
- [ ] No delta file contains REVIEW_RESULT or MIN_SCORE
  Verify: ! grep -rq 'REVIEW_RESULT\|MIN_SCORE' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/docs/workflows/prompts/reviewer-delta-*.md

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
data.title: GREEN: Update all 10 reviewer delta files — remove N/A scores, add negative scope constraints
